epic.title: Design Updates (fix version 0.4)
epic.functionalNeed: Consolidated EPIC grouping all design-related stories, tasks, and bugs targeted for fix version 0.4. Replaces the previous Design QA - Batch #01 (GEO-337) and Design QA - Batch #02 (GEO-406) containers.
scope: LLM ordering standardisation (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity)
Onboarding wizard UX improvements (step indicator, question type explanations, AI engines message)
Category view bug fixes (LLM buttons, Citation Signal cards)
Manage Scope bug fixes (Brand Image delete, Add Market helper text)
Report list bug fixes (brand logos display and mismatch)
KPI and Brand Rankings tooltips (SOV trim, Visibility / Avg Position / LLM Choice addition)
Chart interaction fixes (quadrant blue selection box)
Corporate Reputation expand alignment with Questions table
Last analysis screen design (replace loading stage)
Homepage and empty state terminology rename: Reports -> Analysis
Top Concepts panel source items clickability and LLM logo display
Citation Sources scroll and resize fix
outOfScope: Data fetching or component contract changes (structural refactor story)
Rewriting non-applicable body copy in empty state beyond Report/Reports -> Analysis/Analyses rename

stories.title: GEO Analytics report — structural refactor (layout / visual)
technicalNotes: 1. Remove horizontal 'Top Section' bar (back-arrow + brand logo + brand name + generated date + filter dropdowns)
2. Relocate brand block into left sidebar (top, height ~69px, sidebar width 240px -> 254px)
3. Merge filter dropdowns into section-tab row (tabs left, filters right, single row, no wrap >= 1280px)
4. Delete in-content 'Overview' H1 heading
5. Drop named section containers (remove Corporate Reputation wrapper card and heading)
6. Add uppercase section anchors: IDENTITY, PERFORMANCE, SOURCES (Inter 700 16px uppercase letter-spacing 0.04em)
7. Apply new spacing rhythm: 16px gap within section, 24px gap between sections
Constraints: no data fetching or component contract changes; verify at 1280, 1440, 1920px
Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/xctSRqtM653zRS7QY3KMm0/Measure---GEO-Module?node-id=6368-78934
